from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSlotsStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY).symbol
            for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        ]
        self.spy = self.symbols[0]
        self.aapl = self.symbols[1]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY)

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        # Continuously compute market-state quantities from available bars.
        if data.bars.contains_key(self.spy):
            self.spy_closes.add(float(data.bars[self.spy].close))

        if data.bars.contains_key(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = float(data.bars[self.aapl].close)
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        # Skip all rule evaluation if any subscribed ticker lacks today's bar.
        if any(not data.bars.contains_key(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        # Do not trade until every required indicator/window is fully formed.
        if self.spy_closes.count < 101 or not self.aapl_rsi.is_ready or self.previous_aapl_close is None:
            return

        spy_close = float(data.bars[self.spy].close)
        aapl_close = float(data.bars[self.aapl].close)

        current_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        previous_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0
        previous_spy_close = self.spy_closes[1]

        spy_crossed_above_sma = previous_spy_close <= previous_sma and spy_close > current_sma
        spy_crossed_below_sma = previous_spy_close >= previous_sma and spy_close < current_sma

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crossed_below_sma:
            self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60:
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crossed_above_sma:
            shares = int((self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40) // spy_close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.market_order(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentStrategySlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY).symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = self.sma(self.spy, 100, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY)

        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        required_symbols = list(self.symbols.values())

        for symbol in required_symbols:
            if data.bars.contains_key(symbol):
                if symbol == self.aapl:
                    self.aapl_closes.add(float(data.bars[symbol].close))

        if not all(data.bars.contains_key(symbol) for symbol in required_symbols):
            self._update_spy_cross_history(data)
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.is_ready or not self.aapl_rsi.is_ready or self.aapl_closes.count < 4:
            self._update_spy_cross_history(data)
            return

        spy_close = float(data.bars[self.spy].close)
        aapl_close = float(data.bars[self.aapl].close)

        spy_crossed_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > self.spy_sma.current.value
        )
        spy_crossed_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < self.spy_sma.current.value
        )

        aapl_red_three_days = (
            self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1]
            and self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2]
            and self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
        )

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60:
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            quantity = int((self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40) / spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and aapl_red_three_days:
            if self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self._update_spy_cross_history(data)

    def _update_spy_cross_history(self, data: Slice):
        if data.bars.contains_key(self.spy) and self.spy_sma.is_ready:
            self.previous_spy_close = float(data.bars[self.spy].close)
            self.previous_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.current.value)

        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)

        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Simple)
        self.RegisterIndicator(self.spy, self.spy_sma, Resolution.Daily)
        self.RegisterIndicator(self.aapl, self.aapl_rsi, Resolution.Daily)

        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

    def OnData(self, data):
        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            if symbol not in data.Bars:
                return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        self.aapl_closes.Add(aapl_bar.Close)

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self._store_spy_history(spy_bar.Close)
            return

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
            if (self.previous_spy_close is not None and
                    self.previous_spy_sma is not None and
                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma and
                    spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value):
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0:
            if self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
            if (self.previous_spy_close is not None and
                    self.previous_spy_sma is not None and
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma and
                    spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value):
                target_value = self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40
                shares = int(target_value // spy_bar.Close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_closes.IsReady:
            red_for_three_days = (
                self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1] and
                self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2] and
                self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
            )

            if red_for_three_days and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.Close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

        self._store_spy_history(spy_bar.Close)

    def _store_spy_history(self, close):
        if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.lots = {
            "StrategyA": 0,
            "StrategyB": 0
        }

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl) else None

        sma_cross_up = False
        sma_cross_down = False

        if spy_bar is not None:
            prior_close = self.previous_spy_close
            prior_sma = self.previous_spy_sma

            self.spy_sma.Update(IndicatorDataPoint(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close))

            if (prior_close is not None and
                    prior_sma is not None and
                    self.spy_sma.IsReady):
                sma_cross_up = (
                    prior_close <= prior_sma and
                    spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )
                sma_cross_down = (
                    prior_close >= prior_sma and
                    spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(IndicatorDataPoint(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close))
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not (self.spy_sma.IsReady and
                self.previous_spy_sma is not None and
                self.aapl_rsi.IsReady and
                self.previous_aapl_close is not None):
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.lots["StrategyA"] > 0 and sma_cross_down:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.lots["StrategyA"], tag="StrategyA")

        if self.lots["StrategyB"] > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.lots["StrategyB"], tag="StrategyB")

        if self.lots["StrategyA"] == 0 and sma_cross_up:
            quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_bar.Close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity, tag="StrategyA")

        if self.lots["StrategyB"] == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity, tag="StrategyB")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event: OrderEvent):
        if order_event.FillQuantity == 0:
            return

        order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(order_event.OrderId)
        if order is None or order.Tag not in self.lots:
            return

        self.lots[order.Tag] += int(order_event.FillQuantity)
        if self.lots[order.Tag] < 0:
            self.lots[order.Tag] = 0

class IndependentSlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0
        self.strategy_a_pending = False
        self.strategy_b_pending = False

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if self.spy in data.Bars else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if self.aapl in data.Bars else None

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if (
                self.previous_aapl_close is not None
                and aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close
            ):
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        all_bars_present = all(symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols)

        if (
            all_bars_present
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
        ):
            spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            current_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

            strategy_a_sell = (
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < current_sma
            )
            strategy_a_buy = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > current_sma
            )

            # Sells are evaluated before buys.
            if (
                self.strategy_a_lot > 0
                and not self.strategy_a_pending
                and strategy_a_sell
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(
                    self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot, tag="strategy_a_sell"
                )
                self.strategy_a_pending = True

            if (
                self.strategy_b_lot > 0
                and not self.strategy_b_pending
                and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(
                    self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot, tag="strategy_b_sell"
                )
                self.strategy_b_pending = True

            if (
                self.strategy_a_lot == 0
                and not self.strategy_a_pending
                and strategy_a_buy
            ):
                quantity = int(
                    (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close
                )
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity, tag="strategy_a_buy")
                    self.strategy_a_pending = True

            if (
                self.strategy_b_lot == 0
                and not self.strategy_b_pending
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
            ):
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity, tag="strategy_b_buy")
                    self.strategy_b_pending = True

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        if order_event.Status not in [OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled, OrderStatus.Filled,
                                      OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
            return

        order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(order_event.OrderId)
        if order is None:
            return

        if order.Tag.startswith("strategy_a"):
            if order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled, OrderStatus.Filled]:
                self.strategy_a_lot += int(order_event.FillQuantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = max(0, self.strategy_a_lot)
            if order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled,
                                      OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.strategy_a_pending = False

        elif order.Tag.startswith("strategy_b"):
            if order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled, OrderStatus.Filled]:
                self.strategy_b_lot += int(order_event.FillQuantity)
                self.strategy_b_lot = max(0, self.strategy_b_lot)
            if order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled,
                                      OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.strategy_b_pending = False

from AlgorithmImports import *


class PrivateLotStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in self.tickers:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        self.spy_closes.Add(spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_closes.Add(aapl_bar.Close)

        if not self.spy_closes.IsReady or not self.aapl_closes.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and self._spy_crossed_below_sma():
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and self._spy_crossed_above_sma():
            shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) // spy_bar.Close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self._aapl_red_three_days():
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.Close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

    def _spy_crossed_above_sma(self):
        today_close = self.spy_closes[0]
        yesterday_close = self.spy_closes[1]
        today_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        yesterday_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0
        return yesterday_close <= yesterday_sma and today_close > today_sma

    def _spy_crossed_below_sma(self):
        today_close = self.spy_closes[0]
        yesterday_close = self.spy_closes[1]
        today_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        yesterday_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0
        return yesterday_close >= yesterday_sma and today_close < today_sma

    def _aapl_red_three_days(self):
        return (
            self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1]
            and self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2]
            and self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
        )

from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentDailyStrategies(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = [

            self.add_equity("AAPL", Resolution.DAILY).symbol,
            self.add_equity("IBM", Resolution.DAILY).symbol,
            self.add_equity("BAC", Resolution.DAILY).symbol,
            self.add_equity("AIG", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.symbols[0]
        self.aapl = self.symbols[1]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.rsi = self.rsi(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY)

        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if data.bars.contains_key(symbol):
                bar = data.bars[symbol]
                if symbol == self.spy:
                    self.spy_closes.add(bar.close)
                elif symbol == self.aapl:
                    if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                        if bar.close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                        else:
                            self.aapl_red_streak = 0
                    self.aapl_previous_close = bar.close

        if not all(data.bars.contains_key(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_bar = data.bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.bars[self.aapl]

        spy_cross = False
        if self.spy_closes.is_ready:
            current_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
            previous_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0
            previous_close = self.spy_closes[1]

            spy_cross = (
                (previous_close <= previous_sma and spy_bar.close > current_sma) or
                (previous_close >= previous_sma and spy_bar.close < current_sma)
            )

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_cross:
            self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.rsi.is_ready and self.rsi.current.value > 60:
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_cross:
            quantity = int((self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40) // spy_bar.close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0
            and self.rsi.is_ready
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            and self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000
        ):
            quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
                self.strategy_b_lot = quantity
